top5.title: Subtractive genetic circuits improve organoid development
top5.why: Synthetic gene circuits can selectively eliminate immature cells during organoid development, enriching for mature cell populations.

top5.title: Single-cell and spatial characterization of the human pancreas in cystic fibrosis
top5.why: Beta cell dysfunction in cystic fibrosis-related diabetes involves niche-specific signaling from adipocytes, macrophages, stellate cells, and ductal cells distinct from type 1/2 diabetes pathology.

top5.title: Spatial and single-cell insights into the prostate cancer microenvironment: overcoming immunotherapy resistance through multidimensional strategies
top5.why: Prostate cancer's resistance to immunotherapy stems from multicellular immune suppression involving TAMs, Tregs, CAFs, and MDSCs shaped by PTEN/TP53 mutations and epigenetic dysregulation, requiring combination therapies targeting chemotaxis and metabolism rather than checkpoint inhibition alone.

top5.title: Converging pathomechanisms link SARS-CoV-2 infection with major neurodegenerative diseases
top5.authors: HeFeng FQ … on the behalf of WP4, the COMMUTE Consortium
top5.why: SARS-CoV-2 infection shares molecular mechanisms with neurodegenerative diseases through systemic inflammation, BBB dysfunction, neuroinflammation, mitochondrial dysfunction, and protein aggregation.

top5.title: Sex-biased enhancers shape transcriptional sex differences across human tissues
top5.why: Nearly half of active enhancers show sex-biased activity across tissues, frequently organized into super-enhancers derived from transposable elements and regulating genes linked to sex-differentiated traits.

also.title: Aqueous humor exosomal microRNAs as emerging biomarkers in HSV-1 anterior uveitis
also.why: Aqueous humor exosomal microRNAs offer potential biomarkers for HSV-1 anterior uveitis by providing molecular information beyond viral DNA detection in the intraocular environment.

also.title: RNA biology and therapeutics: emerging mechanisms, technologies, and future leaders
also.why: Primary research in a leading general journal.

also.title: Modeling perinatal brain injury with human brain organoids: from pathophysiology to treatment development
also.why: Human brain organoids enable modeling of perinatal brain injury pathophysiology and drug discovery by recapitulating fetal-neonatal development's cellular complexity, gene expression, and electrophysiological properties.

also.title: In vivo CAR-T double knockout screen maps synergistic antitumour gene pairs
also.why: In vivo CRISPR screening identifies NR4A1-SOCS3 deletion as synergistically enhancing CAR-T metabolic fitness and antitumor activity beyond single-gene modifications.

also.title: Temporal clinical trajectories and Day+14 landmark stratification of infection risk after CD19 CAR T-cell therapy
also.why: Day+14 clinical data can stratify infection risk after CD19 CAR-T therapy, identifying a low-risk subgroup suitable for reduced monitoring protocols.

also.title: Assessment of cytotoxicity of human CAR-NK cells against various canine tumor cell lines
also.why: Human CAR-NK cells engineered to target CD19 kill canine tumor cells more effectively than unmodified NK cells, suggesting cross-species CAR recognition of canine CD19.
